text_1981: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
text_1989: In the name of God,
text_ref: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

text_1981: By the night as it gets dark.
text_1989: By the night as it covers.
text_ref: By the night as it covers.

text_1981: By the day as it gets bright.
text_1989: The day as it reveals.
text_ref: The day as it reveals.

text_1981: By Him who created the male and the female.
text_1989: And Him who created the male and the female.
text_ref: And Him who created the male and the female.

text_1981: Your works are of various kinds.
text_1989: Your works are of various kinds.
text_ref: Your works are of various kinds.

text_1981: As for the one who is charitable and righteous.
text_1989: As for him who gives to charity and maintains righteousness.
text_ref: As for him who gives to charity and maintains righteousness.

text_1981: Who upholds the scripture.
text_1989: And upholds the scripture.
text_ref: And upholds the scripture.

text_1981: We will direct him towards happiness.
text_1989: We will direct him towards happiness.
text_ref: We will direct him towards happiness.

text_1981: But the one who is stingy and arrogant.
text_1989: But he who is stingy, though he is rich.
text_ref: But he who is stingy, though he is rich.

text_1981: And rejects the scripture.
text_1989: And disbelieves in the scripture.
text_ref: And disbelieves in the scripture.

text_1981: We will direct him towards misery.
text_1989: We will direct him towards misery.
text_ref: We will direct him towards misery.

text_1981: His money will never help him, once he falls.
text_1989: His money cannot help him when he falls.
text_ref: His money cannot help him when he falls.

text_1981: It is us who guide.
text_1989: We provide the guidance.
text_ref: We provide the guidance.

text_1981: To us belong the last, as well as the first.
text_1989: We control the Hereafter, as well as this life.
text_ref: We control the Hereafter, as well as this life.

text_1981: I have warned you of a blazing hell.
text_1989: I have warned you about the blazing Hellfire. 2 r
text_ref: I have warned you about the blazing Hellfire.

text_1981: Burning therein are the wicked.
text_1989: None burns therein except the wicked.
text_ref: None burns therein except the wicked.

text_1981: Who disbelieved and turned away.
text_1989: Who disbelieves and turns away.
text_ref: Who disbelieves and turns away.

text_1981: Spared from it is the righteous.
text_1989: Avoiding it will be the righteous.
text_ref: Avoiding it will be the righteous.

text_1981: Who gives his money in charity.
text_1989: Who gives from his money to charity.
text_ref: Who gives from his money to charity.

text_1981: Expecting nothing in return.
text_1989: Seeking nothing in return.
text_ref: Seeking nothing in return.

text_1981: Seeking only his Lord, the most high.
text_1989: Seeking only his Lord, the Most High.
text_ref: Seeking only his Lord, the Most High.

text_1981: He will certainly rejoice. t
text_1989: He will certainly attain salvation. 596
text_ref: He will certainly attain salvation.
